text:
maria: Heads-up: gem release job failed on ruby-3.2 matrix for the sampleapp onboarding. Release step error: `uninitialized constant Client::Auth`. CI trace -> https://ci.redwood/452

alex: Link to the PR?

maria: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sampleapp/pull/123 — looks like SDK changed initializer kwarg from `token:` to `api_key:` but README still shows REDWOOD_TOKEN env var.

sam: Ah, we changed to `Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])` in the SDK a while back. Release job still sets REDWOOD_TOKEN in the workflow.

jen: CI workflow uses REDWOOD_TOKEN in .github/workflows/release.yml — quick patch to the workflow or add a fallback in the SDK. Node SDK kept TOKEN for compat.

maria: I'm leaning to adding a fallback in SDK that reads `ENV['REDWOOD_TOKEN']` if `REDWOOD_API_KEY` missing and emits a deprecation warning for one release cycle. I'll open a tiny PR.

alex: Also noticed gemspec still says `required_ruby >= "3.0"` but some test/helpers use 3.1+ syntax (numbered params). CI on 3.0 fails. Either bump required_ruby or revert those bits.

sam: Oops, I accidentally left a pattern-matching patch in tests. Can revert — low risk.

ci-bot: deploy-bot: build #452 failed on ruby-3.2 — full logs: https://ci.redwood/452

jen: :thumbsup: Thanks. Maria, want a quick review when you open the PR?

maria: Yep. Quick checklist I'll include in the PR body: 
- add `REDWOOD_TOKEN` fallback with deprecation warn
- update README to show `REDWOOD_API_KEY` example
- fix/remove 3.1-only syntax or bump gemspec ruby range
- add a comment in CI matrix explaining the ruby lanes

alex: If you want, I can add a changelog entry for the gem release (notes under "deprecations" vs "breaking").

maria: Not a breaking change, will add it under deprecations.

sam: One additional micro-thing — sampleapp uses `Net::HTTP` without persistent connection in tests which slows local runs. Not release-blocking but filed an issue.

maria: Filed issue #456 for Net::HTTP perf. Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/789

jen: After merge let's do a quick smoke release to staging and watch the gem release job.

maria: Will coordinate and ping here when it's out. Thanks all!
